messages.subject: load nvimcom for different R environments
messages.subject_clean: load nvimcom for different R environments
messages.body_plain:
Hi,
I'm using nvim-r with neovim and tmux on a cluster where we load different R versions via
module files into the current environment.
Is it possible to start the automatic installation for every environment or how should this be done?
Any suggestions?

Thanks

messages.subject: Re: load nvimcom for different R environments
messages.subject_clean: load nvimcom for different R environments
messages.body_plain:
You can install nvimcom manually with the following commands:

cd /path/to/Nvim-R/R
R CMD build nvimcom
R CMD INSTALL nvimcom_0.9-25.tar.gz

To install nvimcom for different R versions, you have to run the last command with each R version.

Dear Mr. Aquino,
I am quite new to both Linux and VIM and I am running into a quite mysterious problem:
my .vimrc file is in the home directory ( ~/.vimrc )
its content is just the following line:
set number

The NVim-R plugin is not working ( ~/.vim/pack/my-plugins/opt/NVim-R ),
but if I delete my .vimrc file everything runs smoothly.
Could you please give me an hint on how to run the plugin with an edited .vimrc file for VIM 8.0.134?
Thanks a lot for your help

messages.subject: Re: Nvim-R 0.9.8 released
messages.body_plain:
You have to enable filetype plugin. Please, put these lines in your vimrc:

filetype indent plugin on
syntax on
